description: Consumo de electricidad en centros de la administración autonómica de Castilla y León is a dataset listed in analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. Consumo eléctrico en todos los centros de consumo energético de la administración autonómica de Castilla y León. Coverage: Castilla y León. The portal files it under Energy. Its keywords are centros, consumo energético, electricidad, administración autonómica. The portal shows 119,335 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-analisis-datosabiertos-jcyl-es-portal.
